work.title: Robot, Keyboard Mouth
work.description: Frontal robot-like assemblage constructed from red plastic-wrapped forms, two iridescent compact discs positioned as eyes, a reel-to-reel unit as nose, and a beige computer keyboard spanning the midsection as mouth; floppy disk casings top the head, and vertical red-and-blue striped legs descend against a black ground.
work.composition: anthropomorphic central figure on black ground
